unchanged.signal: previous_actual_session_only; no execution-day quote in selection
unchanged.historical_membership: signal-date CSI300 plus CSI1000; held out-of-index assets remain in account

holding_clock.formula: index(planned execution session) minus index(actual first BUY in current tradable holding epoch)
holding_clock.example: BUY at D0 can exit at a scheduled D10 rebalance when minimum_hold_sessions=10
holding_clock.partial_sale_or_additional_buy: does not reset an existing tradable holding epoch
holding_clock.stock_dividend_and_capital_transfer: inherit evidenced record-date actual holding origin
holding_clock.confirmed_share_exchange: inherit predecessor origin; when combined with an existing successor use the earlier evidenced origin
holding_clock.unknown_origin: fail closed; never infer from latest quote or registry IPO
holding_clock.tradable_active: positive actual positions or pending bonus integer-share delivery
holding_clock.fractional_claim: retain original ledger and separate source audit; cannot extend a cleared tradable epoch or give a new BUY an old age
holding_clock.reentry: actual new BUY restarts age after no actual shares and no pending integer delivery

replacement_semantics.cap_unit: number of distinct planned exit securities per scheduled rebalance, not promised completed sales
replacement_semantics.eligible_exit: original buffer would exit and minimum holding age is met
replacement_semantics.priority: missing signal rank first, then descending rank number, then ascending instrument
replacement_semantics.locked_or_over_cap: retain actual shares unchanged and occupy target slots, including out-of-index or unscored securities
replacement_semantics.initial_build_and_vacancies: may fill target vacancies; not counted as replacements
replacement_semantics.failed_execution: same original executor, no replacement stock or replanning after observing execution-day tradability
replacement_semantics.actual_holdings_above_target: possible after refused exits under the unchanged baseline executor; explicitly audited, no new BUY slot rule
replacement_semantics.forced_retained_above_target: retain every locked security and submit no new entries; never force an early exit

validity_and_comparison.baseline_before_treatments: reproduce all three original LGB paths: metrics, final state and canonical records; mismatch stops all treatments
validity_and_comparison.invalid_path: keep diagnostic records, exclude from qualified performance and ranking
validity_and_comparison.execution_improvement: valid in every period; continuous return strictly higher, drawdown no worse and turnover strictly lower than baseline
validity_and_comparison.retain_five_day_signal_for_next_forward_: at least one predeclared variant passes execution_improvement and has positive net return in2025, partial2026 and continuous
validity_and_comparison.otherwise: longer-horizon20-session label research is justified as a next separate experiment; no20-day model is trained in this run
validity_and_comparison.window_interpretation: already examined retrospective historical comparison, not fresh future out-of-sample evidence
validity_and_comparison.multiple_tests: all four treatments reported; no new grid points or parameter changes after seeing candidate results
